1.explanation: This minimal app imports Carbon’s Form, FormGroup, and Search components. By rendering Search inside a FormGroup (with legendText), you’ll reproduce the collapsed 16 px input height. Make sure you’re on the latest Carbon React package and CSS to observe the styling regression. If everything is wired correctly, the Search input bar will display at the wrong height, matching the bug screenshot.
1.bug_scenario: When you render a Search field inside a Carbon Form (for example in Storybook’s “components-form--default” story), the text‐input area collapses to about 16 px in height instead of the expected 40–48 px. The label floats above a very thin input bar (see screenshot).
